ADVISOR CI finding at exact PR2919 head766bbcbc4c726118d625002f04583111b3fdbaed: CI40186656417 contracts job121148770301 is FAILURE. Raw job log /tmp/advisor-pr2919-766-contracts.log lines1825-1831: tests/test_distributed.sh Test1, --file "$TEST_DIR/store1" add, fails "allocation requires a clone-local Git identity". This is NEW evidence after earlier history/latency fixture repairs; the five library/CLI/REST lanes passed, gates still running at observation.
Read source tests/test_distributed.sh:76-80: store1 is only mkdir, outside Git. Later positive fixtures also include ordinary init and sibling init; current script swallows init exit in Test8. Do NOT blindly rerun CI or weaken missing-authority WORK refusal. At the safe checkpoint after BUG2222 publish, repair actual declared fixture topology: explicit private Git/HOME enrollment for positive global-ID behavior only, preserving exact common-Git ownership and isolated HOME, and retain decisive no-flag/unsupported/non-Git negative checks. Distinguish a signed unsupported-writer refusal from a production compatibility regression; a test-only enrollment is not proof ordinary WORK bootstrap works. Ordinary cold WORK init remains signed S2 landing dependency; do not promote this slice first and break main users. No real HOME flag, Git-template/env authority bypass, or swallowed refusals. Inspect the remaining contracts scripts for the same setup boundary to avoid one-failure-at-a-time CI churn, but make only source-grounded positive-fixture corrections, no blanket enroll-all policy.
Focused gate: existing affected contract scripts against the pinned candidate binary, allocation negative controls, make check-ci-fast. No broad workspace runtime or slot bypass; shared-infrastructure/>10-file changes use required touched+compile-only evidence. Long Cargo runs background with AIDA_CARGO_TIMEOUT and inspect cargo ps after lost handle/timeout, no blind retries. Normal push only. Independent reviewer assesses the actual new head and complete existing slice scope; no stale approval. Existing canonical verdict .aida/review-verdicts/PR-2919.json is c25 RequestChanges, retained until actual fresh attestation.
subject: PR2919 exact766 CI failure: distributed contract lacks Git identity
